evidence_boundary: Scripted integration and deterministic original-field evidence checks; not real-model recovery, human gold or approval.
limitations: The original comparison AST is model-generated, not ground truth; every protected conversion needs original-field compiler support.

Protection checks explicit enum lookups over a field or trim/collapse_ws input where the complete original expression emits the expected value on the isolated witness; predicate values are never invented.
Witnesses are isolated execution inputs, never source records, evaluation gold or formal extraction output.
At most 256 distinct conversion checks with 16 detailed diagnostic entries; exceeding the check bound fails explicitly.
A changed existing enum plan adds a checkpointed comparison generation step. Real-provider correction requests may add calls; live latency and cost remain unmeasured.
No claim of arbitrary conditional AST equivalence, LLM backend coverage protection, real Haiku repair success or improved six-source coverage.

live_companies_retest.fnos_causal_limitation: FNOS was introduced in a later candidate, not directly restored by an FNOS guard event. One historical comparison does not isolate causal effect.
